subject: general
question: What is the minimum age for employment in factories or mines or other hazardous 4 employment, according to Article 24 of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __14 years**.**__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 24__ of the Indian Constitution prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories, mines, and other hazardous employment.
 
• It aims to safeguard children from exploitation and ensure their right to education and a safe childhood.
 
• This provision is a part of Fundamental Rights under the Indian Constitution, ensuring the protection of children.
 
• It is in line with international conventions such as the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC).
 
• Further, the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act strictly enforces this prohibition with additional guidelines.
 
• The goal is to eliminate child labour in hazardous environments and encourage universal education.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act:**

 
 
• The Act prohibits the employment of children below 14 years in certain occupations and processes.
 
• It also regulates conditions of work for children in non-hazardous jobs.
 
 
 
• **Right to Education:**
 
 
• The Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009, ensures education for children aged 6-14 years.
 
• It complements Article 24 to eradicate child labour and promote education.
